question: Show Bladder PD-L1 trials conducted in 2018 or later.

gemini.answer: This query selects the NCT ID, author, year, cancer type, ICI class and trial phase for all clinical trials of bladder cancer involving PD-L1 inhibitors published in 2018 or later.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"cancer_type\", \"ici_class\", \"trial_phase\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%Bladder%' AND \"ici_class\" = 'PD-L1' AND \"year\" >= 2018",
  "answer": "This query selects the NCT ID, author, year, cancer type, ICI class and trial phase for all clinical trials of bladder cancer involving PD-L1 inhibitors published in 2018 or later.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
